import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            if (i == 0) {
                a = b = x;
            } else {
                if (x < a) a = x;
                if (x > b) b = x;
            }
        }
        System.out.println((a + b) / 2);
        sc.close();
    }
}
